title: Ezekiel Bible Quiz - Chapter 34
description: Ten questions on Ezekiel 34: the shepherds who fed themselves, the scattered sheep sought out again, and the one shepherd set over them.

questions.text: Against whom was the prophet told to prophesy at the start of this chapter?
questions.explanation: He was told to prophesy against the shepherds of Israel and say: woe to the shepherds of Israel who feed themselves.

answers.text: Against the kings of the nations
Against the priests of the sanctuary
Against the shepherds of Israel
Against the merchants of the cities

questions.text: Which three things does the chapter say the shepherds did while not feeding the sheep?
questions.explanation: It says: you eat the fat, you clothe yourself with the wool, you kill the fatlings, but you do not feed the sheep.

answers.text: They ate the fat, wore the wool and killed the fatlings
They sold the lambs, bought fields and built houses
They counted the flock, marked the rams and shore the ewes
They led them out, watered them and brought them home

questions.text: What does the chapter say the shepherds had not done for the sick and the broken?
questions.explanation: It says they had not strengthened the diseased, healed the sick, bound up the broken, brought back the driven away or sought the lost, but had ruled with force and rigor.

answers.text: They had not counted them at the gate
They had not brought them to the mountains
They had not offered them in sacrifice
They had not healed them or bound up the broken

questions.text: Why were the sheep scattered, according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: It says they were scattered because there was no shepherd, and they became food to all the animals of the field.

answers.text: Because the rains did not come
Because there was no shepherd
Because the mountains were burned
Because the flock was too great

questions.text: What does the Lord Yahweh say he will require at the hand of the shepherds?
questions.explanation: He says: behold, I am against the shepherds; I will require my sheep at their hand, and cause them to cease from feeding the sheep.

answers.text: Their wool and their fat
Their rods and their staffs
His sheep
Their fields and their folds

questions.text: Who does the chapter say will seek out the scattered sheep?
questions.explanation: He says: behold, I myself, even I, will search for my sheep and will seek them out, as a shepherd seeks out his flock.

answers.text: The Lord Yahweh himself
The hired servants
The rams of the flock
The princes of the land

questions.text: Where does the chapter say the fold of the sheep would be?
questions.explanation: It says he will feed them with good pasture, and their fold will be on the mountains of the height of Israel, where they will lie down in a good fold.

answers.text: Beside the rivers of Babylon
In the gardens of the cities
In the valleys of the sea coast
On the mountains of the height of Israel

questions.text: What were the fat sheep doing to the pasture and the water?
questions.explanation: He asks whether it is a small thing to have fed on the good pasture but to tread down the residue with their feet, and to have drunk the clear waters but foul the residue with their feet.

answers.text: Carrying them away to the other flocks
Treading down and fouling the rest with their feet
Hiding them from the shepherds of Israel
Selling them to the merchants of the city

questions.text: Whom does the chapter say would be set up as the one shepherd over them?
questions.explanation: It says: I will set up one shepherd over them, and he will feed them, even my servant David, and he will be their shepherd.

answers.text: His servant Jacob
His servant Moses
His servant David
His servant Abraham

questions.text: What would come down in its season when the land was blessed?
questions.explanation: He says he will make them and the places around his hill a blessing, and will cause the shower to come down in its season; there will be showers of blessing.

answers.text: The shower
The dew
The wind
The fire
